image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a sliced meatloaf on a white plate. The foreground shows the cut cross-section of the loaf, revealing a dense, moist interior with visible flecks of red (likely tomato or pepper) and green herbs. The exterior crust is browned and appears to have a glossy, reddish glaze. In the blurred background, there are side dishes including orange carrots and yellow potatoes.
